rounds.response:
We will defend the core plan (Wizard = P1, Starter Packs = P2, Adoption/Instrumentation = P3) and reserve a firm ~10% dev capacity buffer for critical exceptions and reliability; everything else remains deferred this quarter.  
Allowed exceptions: (A) legal/security/compliance fixes, (B) deal‑blocking requests that are small (<=3 dev days + <=1 QA sprint) AND generalize to our target roles, or (C) cross‑cutting UX fixes that measurably improve one of the four hero journeys (connect, build, schedule, publish) — each must have a named business sponsor.  
Approval process: submit a 1‑page ask (impact, scope, rollback plan), then get sign‑off from Sales sponsor, PM (me), Head of Eng (feasibility/no slip) and UX lead at the weekly triage; any approved exception will replace the smallest stretch item(s) in this priority order: extra template variants → personalization → cohort analytics → predictive signals.  
If an exception can’t be absorbed without harming core milestones we’ll mark it “Not this quarter,” offer a documented workaround or pilot‑support plan, and push it to the backlog with acceptance criteria and a review date; accepted exceptions are timeboxed and instrumented to validate generalizability.  
I’ll circulate a short “Yes / Not now / No” communication template for Sales/CS and run the first triage next Tuesday after you confirm the 10% buffer so reps get a clear, consistent answer path.

GA criteria & scope (all required): core Wizard (role select, data validation, apply starter dashboard, publish & schedule) working end‑to‑end with ≥40% completion and median time‑to‑first‑dashboard ≤10 days in pilot cohorts; Starter Packs (2 dashboards/role) with ≥40% pilot adoption; capture the 3 core expansion signals; zero P0/P1 bugs on GA flows; security/compliance sign‑off, docs, and Sales enablement complete.  
Must‑fix vs defer: Must‑fix — field‑mapping failures that block applying starter dashboards, scheduled‑report discoverability/fallback, the pilot permission quirk, critical perf/stability bugs, and missing telemetry for core events; Defer — advanced personalization/auto‑mapping, template marketplace, cohort/predictive analytics, extra dashboard variants beyond 2/role.

Next‑quarter anchor themes: (1) smarter data mapping & personalization to shorten TTFV, (2) expansion automation & predictive signals to drive seat growth, (3) scale & self‑service for templates (authoring/marketplace) tied to revenue motions.  
If you approve this bar, we’ll schedule the must‑fix work into the next two sprints (4 weeks) and target a GA declaration at the end of that window; otherwise propose an alternate deadline and I’ll rework priorities.
